_why: Module 3 deep-dive checks (labs/m3/deep-dive.checks.json), REAL, no cluster. They read the evidence file the deep dive writes at the clone root, evidence/m3-claim-grades.md, which is outside the platform repository and never committed.

They assert content per row, never the heading: three rows, a stage word in every Stage read cell, and every Source URL pinned to a 40-hex commit or the v1.0.5 release asset. An absent file prints rows=0.

checks.describe: evidence/m3-claim-grades.md: the evidence table under the header | Evidence type | Claim | Stage read | Source URL | has exactly three data rows
checks.run: f=evidence/m3-claim-grades.md; [ -f "$f" ] || { echo 'rows=0 file=missing'; exit 0; }; awk -F'|' '/^\| *Evidence type *\|/{s=1;next} s&&/^\|[-| :]+\|[ \t]*$/{next} s&&!/^\|/{s=0} s&&/^\|/{r++} END{printf "rows=%d\n", r}' "$f"

checks.describe: evidence/m3-claim-grades.md: every row's Stage read cell holds one of alpha, beta, stable or served, as a word
checks.run: f=evidence/m3-claim-grades.md; [ -f "$f" ] || { echo 'rows=0 nostage=missing-file'; exit 0; }; awk -F'|' '/^\| *Evidence type *\|/{s=1;next} s&&/^\|[-| :]+\|[ \t]*$/{next} s&&!/^\|/{s=0} s&&/^\|/{r++; if($4 !~ /(^|[^a-z])(alpha|beta|stable|served)([^a-z]|$)/) n++} END{printf "rows=%d nostage=%d\n", r, n}' "$f"

checks.describe: evidence/m3-claim-grades.md: every row's Source URL is https:// and pinned, either by a 40-hex commit SHA or by the releases/download/v1.0.5/ asset path
checks.run: f=evidence/m3-claim-grades.md; [ -f "$f" ] || { echo 'rows=0 unpinned=missing-file'; exit 0; }; awk -F'|' 'BEGIN{h="[0-9a-f]"; p=""; for(i=0;i<40;i++) p=p h;} /^\| *Evidence type *\|/{s=1;next} s&&/^\|[-| :]+\|[ \t]*$/{next} s&&!/^\|/{s=0} s&&/^\|/{r++; u=$5; gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/,"",u); if(u !~ /^https:\/\// || (u !~ p && index(u,"/releases/download/v1.0.5/")==0)) n++} END{printf "rows=%d unpinned=%d\n", r, n}' "$f"
